acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is highly recommended to contact a qualified plumber for rusty hot water issues. Diagnosing the exact cause of rusty water can be complex, involving inspecting your water heater, anode rod, and internal plumbing. A professional plumber has the tools and expertise to identify the source accurately and recommend the most effective solution, whether it's a repair, flush, or replacement. Alpha-Plumbing Services proudly serves Goodyear, Buckeye, Avondale, Surprise, and Waddel, providing expert plumbing services.
